headline: Stonecradle and Expanse Surge as Shelf Reawakens
war_summary: Three hours onward brings fresh movement on several fronts, with the Weathered Expanse now counted at five Warden, three Colonial and one destroyed after 68 changes in the day and 10 in the last two hours about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, its two-hour tolls quickened to 1,854 Colonial to 2,252 Warden. Stonecradle stands at six Warden to three Colonial after 20 daily changes and nine in two hours at Trammel Pool, The Heir's Knife and World's End, the latest hand in the packet, with two-hour losses surging to 1,620 Colonial to 1,597 Warden. Linn Mercy is now one to ten after 18 daily changes and two in two hours at The Long Whine and Ulster Falls, last entered at 19:39. The Shelf, silent at last filing, shows 55 daily changes and three in two hours about The Old Mourn and Breaker Town, while Godcrofts logs nine daily and two up to the hour about Argosa and Protos and Fisherman's Row logs two at Dankana Post. Farranac Coast, Viper Pit, Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands report no flips in the last two hours.
